raw_text:
Route 1: Sol-gel method for Zn0.1Ni0.9
1. Dissolve nickel(II) nitrate hexahydrate (Ni(NO3)2·6H2O) (10.9 g) and zinc nitrate hexahydrate (Zn(NO3)2·6H2O) (1.19 g) in double distilled water (100 mL) to form a solution. Adjust pH to ~7.0 using ammonia.
2. Add citric acid (5 g) as a complexing agent to the solution and stir until fully dissolved.
3. Gelate the solution at 80 °C for several hours until a gel forms.
4. Dry the gel at 100 °C overnight, then calcine at 500–600 °C for 4 hours to obtain the final product.
Final product: Zn0.1Ni0.9 as spherical nanoparticles with a cubic crystal structure, particle size ~50×50×50 nm, matching PDF reference 78-0429.
